page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 32 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system configuration includes 128.0 GB of RAM, which translates to a resource density of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

A key characteristic of this instance is its massive bundled local storage, which provides 94,489 GB of HDD capacity. This high-density magnetic storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The reliance on HDD technology instead of solid-state drives represents a clear hardware tradeoff, prioritizing raw storage volume and sequential throughput over high-IOPS random read and write performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers a high volume of storage capacity relative to its compute and memory resources. This makes the instance suitable for workloads that require large-scale data retention and sequential processing rather than fast transactional database operations. Appropriate workloads include big data processing, MapReduce tasks, large-scale log analysis, and data archiving.
